faq_heading: Chilliwack Proper East condos and townhomes: your questions answered

faq.q: What did condos and townhomes in Chilliwack Proper East sell for?
faq.a: 37 townhomes sold in Chilliwack Proper East between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $451,500.

faq.q: How long do condos and townhomes take to sell in Chilliwack Proper East?
faq.a: The median was 33 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 96.9% of the last list price (3% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: What price range do most condos and townhomes in Chilliwack Proper East sell in?
faq.a: The middle half of the 37 townhomes that sold in Chilliwack Proper East went for between $368,000 and $605,000, around a median of $451,500.

faq.q: Do condos and townhomes in Chilliwack Proper East sell above asking price?
faq.a: 3% of the 37 townhomes sold for more than the last list price, and the median sale was 96.9% of it.

faq.q: What is a typical strata fee for condos and townhomes in Chilliwack Proper East?
faq.a: Of the 37 sales, 31 listings gave a monthly fee and the median was $403.

faq.q: How old are the condos and townhomes that sold in Chilliwack Proper East?
faq.a: The median year built was 1994 for the 37 townhomes sold in Chilliwack Proper East.

faq.q: How many bedrooms do condos and townhomes in Chilliwack Proper East usually have?
faq.a: The median townhome that sold in Chilliwack Proper East had 3 bedrooms, from the 37 sales between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: Can I book a private showing with Jared?
faq.a: Yes. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, books private showings across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. Call or text 604-928-1361, or use the contact form on this site.

What Chilliwack Proper East condos and townhomes sold for, November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026

37 townhomes sold in Chilliwack Proper East with a median price of $451,500 (the middle half sold between $368,000 and $605,000), taking a median of 33 days to sell at 96.9% of the last list price; 3% sold above list. They had a median $323 per square foot, a median year built of 1994 and a median strata fee of $403 a month. 22 condos sold in Chilliwack Proper East with a median price of $258,250 (the middle half sold between $207,000 and $320,000), taking a median of 56 days to sell at 95.5% of the last list price; 5% sold above list. They had a median $328 per square foot, a median year built of 1992 and a median strata fee of $358 a month.

blocks.text: How Chilliwack Proper East compares with the rest of Chilliwack

The median townhome in Chilliwack Proper East sold for $451,500, 21% below the Chilliwack median of $572,500 across 108 sales. Chilliwack Proper East townhomes took a median 33 days to sell, against 29 days for Chilliwack as a whole.
